title: Improve access to Photos in your app
description: PHPicker is the simplest and most secure way to integrate the Photos library into your app — and it’s getting even better. Learn how to handle ordered selection of images in your app, as well as pre-selecting assets any time the picker is shown. And for apps that need to integrate more deeply with PhotoKit, discover how you can use PHCloudIdentifier to sync photo project content across devices, helping people easily transition their image work between iPhone, iPad, and Mac. We’ll also take you through the latest updates to the Limited Photos Library. Find out how your app can help people easily extend the initial set of images they’ve authorized — including bringing up the selection UI at any time and recognizing when someone makes new or updated selections. Lastly, explore how you can create or access existing photo albums.

resources.title: Selecting Photos and Videos in iOS
resources.description: Improve the user experience of finding and selecting assets by using the Photos picker.

resources.title: PhotoKit
resources.description: Work with image and video assets managed by the Photos app, including those from iCloud Photos and Live Photos.
